name: nextagent
description: NextAgent: a Claude-powered coding agent team with its own tool loop, in a VS Code editor tab.

nextAgent.model.description: Claude model ID used by the agent.

nextAgent.effort.description: How much effort (thinking depth and token spend) the model puts into each turn.

nextAgent.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per model response.

nextAgent.autoApproveReads.description: Run read-only tools (read, list, search) without asking.

nextAgent.commandTimeoutSec.description: Kill terminal commands that run longer than this many seconds.

nextAgent.refusalFallback.description: If the model declines a request, let the API retry it on a fallback model automatically.

nextAgent.teammateModel.description: Model for new teammates. Empty means the same as main (nextAgent.model).

nextAgent.maxTeammates.description: Maximum number of teammates (not counting main).

nextAgent.maxAutoTurns.description: Maximum automatic (message-triggered) agent turns per team before agents pause; refilled whenever you send a message.

nextAgent.maxTurnIterations.description: Maximum model calls in a single agent turn before the turn ends with a notice.

nextAgent.maxTeamOutputTokens.description: Team-wide budget in output-equivalent tokens (output tokens plus input and cache tokens, weighted by price). When it is used up, all agents pause. It refills when you send a message.

nextAgent.defaultMode.description: Permission mode for a new team. Plan: read-only, main presents a plan. Normal: edits and commands need approval. Auto can only be switched on from the mode switcher.

nextAgent.autoSafetyCheck.description: In Auto mode, ask a small model to judge commands that no rule covers. When off, those commands ask you.

nextAgent.autoSafetyModel.description: Model used for the Auto mode safety check.

scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
